newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish paper firm Celuloza public offer seen soon.
newsitem.headline: Polish paper firm Celuloza public offer seen soon.

text.p: Poland's Securities Commission should soon approve for public trade shares of the large paper maker Zaklady Celulozy i Papieru w Swieciu Celuloza SA, deputy treasury minister Leszek Juchniewicz said on Friday.
"I think that Celuloza Swiecie will soon be approved for public trade," Juchniewicz told a news briefing, without elaborating. The initial public offering would follow shortly, he said.
The ministry seeks to place a 15-percent stake in Celuloza on the Warsaw bourse and to offer strategic investors 65 percent of its shares.
Celuloza, which has 25 percent of the Polish paper market, expected to net 80 million zlotys on 714-million-zloty sales in 1996, down from 1995's 110 million-zloty-net and 760 million-zloty-sales.
